answer: In a market where AI agents book ocean freight for quartz, each agent must lock a refundable bond before accepting a shipment, and each bond backs only one active job. Spawning identities therefore adds no capacity without adding collateral. Signed delivery receipts let an escrow contract slash the bond if an agent tries to forge completion by signing conflicting cargo records. An attacker must tie up capital for every fake agent and risks losing it on provable fraud.
